name: German Court Order (Gerichtsbeschluss)
description: German court orders, decisions and judicial correspondence (Beschluss, Urteil, Verfügung). Detects Aktenzeichen in the Roman-numeral department form (3 XVII H 1234), the standard form (12 C 345/22, 2 BvR 1/20) and after an Az./Geschäftszeichen label, labeled birth dates (geb. am 01.02.1970), German phone numbers, street addresses and PLZ + Ort, plus names and e-mails from the built-in detectors. Court names, statutes, paragraph citations, decision dates and amounts (Streitwert, Kosten) stay readable. The court's own address and phone number are covered too: untick Adresse / PLZ Ort / Telefon if you want them visible.
